subject: Kickoff: Latent Programmer for example-driven pipeline synthesis
body:
Hi all,

Kicking off the Latent Programmer evaluation. Platform users keep writing the same data-transformation pipelines by hand from a few input/output examples; program synthesis is the obvious assist. The Latent Programmer approach is attractive because it doesn't decode a program token-by-token blind — it first predicts discrete latent codes as a coarse plan, then decodes the program conditioned on that plan, which the paper shows beats the plain Transformer baseline on synthesis benchmarks.

Milestones (Feb 23 - May 25):
- Mar 27: baseline Transformer (train.py) and latent model (train_latent.py, latent_vocab_size=30 with the 10k-step latent pretraining) both reproducing on the released benchmark setup
- Apr 24: synthesis accuracy on our internal transformation DSL, top-1 and top-10
- May 20: readout with a Q3 scale-up recommendation and its budget ask

Bruno — staffing and compute please. Keep it lean; the big spend, if any, is a Q3 question.

Dmitri
